acceptance: No iterrows or per-row UPDATE in SCD processing.
Loads use a bulk path on DuckDB and PostgreSQL.
TPC-DI validation queries return the same results as the current implementation.
description: The TPC-DI load phase is timed at benchbox/core/tpcdi/benchmark.py:1123-1129. Inside it: etl/sql_backend.py:190-200 converts DataFrames to tuples and executemany in 1000-row batches; etl/scd_processor.py loops with iterrows() at :461, :507, :725, :748, :882, :892 (one UPDATE per row at :725) and builds parameter lists at :605; etl/pipeline.py:341-655 generates facts/dimensions in Python and loads with executemany; tpcdi/benchmark.py:1263 uses pd.read_csv without the pyarrow engine. Use DataFrame/Arrow registration (DuckDB) or COPY, and set-based MERGE/UPDATE for SCD steps.
